omega3.sleep: The EPA and DHA support the brain-cell membranes involved in settled, steady sleep.
omega3.heart: Supports healthy triglyceride levels and the flexibility of your blood vessels.
omega3.brain: DHA is a core structural fat in brain-cell membranes, supporting memory and clear thinking.
omega3.joints: Supports a healthy inflammatory response — what keeps joints feeling comfortable.
omega3.longevity: Helps counter the low-grade inflammation that tends to build up with age.
omega3.digestion: Supports a calm gut lining and healthy inflammatory balance in the digestive tract.
omega3.stress: Supports the brain-cell membranes involved in steady, even mood.

mag_glycinate.sleep: Calms the nervous system and eases muscle tension so sleep comes on more easily.
mag_glycinate.stress: Supports the nervous system's ability to settle after a demanding day.
mag_glycinate.heart: Supports normal heart rhythm and healthy blood-pressure regulation.
mag_glycinate.digestion: Supports the normal muscle movement through the gut that keeps digestion regular.

vit_d3.joints: Supports bone and muscle strength, which is what keeps joints supported and stable.
vit_d3.longevity: Supports bone density and immune resilience — both matter more as the years add up.
vit_d3.energy: Low vitamin D is a common and easily missed reason for flat, low energy.
vit_d3.stress: Supports the mood-related pathways vitamin D is involved in.

b12.energy: Helps your cells release energy from food. Absorption falls with age, PPIs and metformin.
b12.brain: Supports nerve function and the mental clarity that depends on it.
b12.stress: Supports the nervous system and the neurotransmitters behind steady mood.

creatine.energy: Recycles cellular energy in muscle, which is what makes physical effort feel easier.
creatine.brain: The brain runs on the same energy system as muscle, so it supports mental stamina too.
creatine.longevity: Supports muscle mass and strength — the clearest marker of staying capable with age.
creatine.joints: Stronger muscle takes load off the joint itself, so movement feels steadier.

coq10.energy: Works inside the mitochondria where food becomes usable energy; natural levels fall with age.
coq10.heart: The heart is the most energy-hungry muscle in the body, and CoQ10 supports its output.
coq10.longevity: Supports the mitochondrial function that underpins how energetic you feel over time.
coq10.brain: Supports the cellular energy that sustained concentration depends on.

taurine.heart: Supports heart-muscle function and healthy blood-pressure regulation.
taurine.energy: Supports how cells handle minerals and fluid, which steadies energy through the day.
taurine.longevity: One of the amino acids that declines with age and tracks with healthy-ageing markers.
taurine.sleep: Calming without sedation, supporting an easier wind-down in the evening.
taurine.brain: Supports calm, steady focus rather than stimulation.

l_theanine.sleep: Supports a calm, unhurried mind at bedtime without leaving you groggy.
l_theanine.brain: Supports calm, focused attention — alert rather than wired.
l_theanine.stress: Supports relaxation without sedation, so you settle without feeling flat.
l_theanine.energy: Takes the edge off caffeine, so daytime energy feels steadier.

citicoline.brain: Supplies choline for acetylcholine, the neurotransmitter behind memory and focus.

collagen_uc2.joints: A small daily dose that works through the gut's immune tolerance to support joint comfort.
collagen_uc2.longevity: Supports the cartilage and connective tissue that keep you moving well.

probiotic.digestion: Supports the balance of gut bacteria that comfortable, regular digestion depends on.
probiotic.stress: Supports the gut-brain connection involved in steady mood.

dig_enzymes.digestion: Supplies lipase and other enzymes that help break food down, easing fullness after meals.

curcumin.joints: Supports a healthy inflammatory response, which is what joint comfort rests on.
curcumin.longevity: Supports the inflammatory balance associated with healthy ageing.
curcumin.digestion: Supports a calm gut lining and comfortable digestion.
curcumin.heart: Supports healthy blood-vessel function and inflammatory balance.

ashwagandha.stress: An adaptogen that supports the body's cortisol response under sustained pressure.
ashwagandha.sleep: Supports a calmer evening state — often what stands in the way of falling asleep.
